title: Sanitation Helping Hands
categories: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
description: Use this request to Initiate/Cancel/Renew garbage and recycle collection assistance. A Helping Hands Program Application and Declaration of Special Need form must be completed, signed, and returned to Sanitation Headquarters for review and approval. Please note, all customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related sanitation fees. NOTE: Sanitation residential customers who are physically disabled and living without an able-bodied person that can relocate their roll cart(s) to the point of collection may be eligible for the Helping Hands Program at no additional cost. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 5 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to start, renew, or cancel Helping Hands collection assistance.
actions.why: For a residential Sanitation customer who is physically disabled and has no able-bodied person living with them who can move roll carts to the collection point, or an existing participant seeking renewal or cancellation. The 311 request form asks for account number, cart counts, account authority, request type, and collection location. A signed Helping Hands application and Declaration of Special Need must be returned to Sanitation Headquarters for review; ordinary residential charges still apply.
